Text.PrintString("Despite its murky appearance, this is ~g~Vice City.", 4000)
Text.PrintString("You may notice that it is extremely foggy.", 4000)
Text.PrintString("The aberrant weather is a consequence of a Barrier put in place to keep the city safe from outsiders.", 7000)
Text.PrintString("It has been prophesized that upon the completion of 5 tasks, The Barrier will be destroyed.", 5000)
Text.PrintString("With a little bit of perseverance and some time, it can be systematically disabled.", 5000)
Text.PrintString("Unfortunately, although people have tried hitting it with large wooden sticks...", 5000)
Text.PrintString("...nothing they've tried has brought it down.", 4000)
Text.PrintString("Do not attempt to leave the island. Doing so will indubitably lead to your death.", 5000)
Text.PrintString("Due to the inherent protective nature of ~g~The Barrier~w~, you cannot die while inside it.", 5000)
Text.PrintString("Otherwise, you are free to roam around at your leisure.", 5000)
Text.PrintString("Tread carefully. This land is fraught with danger.", 5000)
Text.PrintString("This is the Radar. Use it to help yourself navigate.", 3000)
Text.PrintBigString("Answering the Call to Abandon...", 3000, TextStyle.BottomRight)

then.text: Text.PrintHelpString("Come back once you have completed ~g~Born of Dirt.")

statements.text: Text.PrintString("We have been waiting so long for your arrival...", 5000)
Text.PrintStringNow("Walk into the shop, grab a Hammer, and step up to the counter to continue.", 3000)
Text.PrintHelpString("Hey! You're supposed to pay for that!")
Text.PrintHelpString("Didn't your mother teach you that stealing is wrong!?")
Text.PrintHelpString("Get back to the Hardware Store and pay for the Hammer.")

then.text: Text.PrintHelpString("Come back any time you need the right tool for the wrong job.")

statements.text: Text.PrintHelpString("The Western Starfish Island gate is now open.")

then.text: Text.PrintString("Follow the L to find your workplace.", 3000)

statements.text: Text.PrintBigString("Behind the Mask, Another Mask!", 6000, TextStyle.BottomRight)
Text.PrintString("Well look who it is... You're late! Where the hell have you been?!", 3000)
Text.PrintString("Oh, that... Well, I can explain-", 1000)
Text.PrintString("Shove it. I don't care. We've got a client who wants you to deliver the bike out back.", 5000)
Text.PrintString("He's giving it to his daughter as a homecoming present.", 3000)
Text.PrintString("So make sure it's in mint condition. If you screw up one more time, I'm taking it out of your ass! Comprende?", 5000)
Text.PrintString("You have ten seconds to get on the ~b~bike.", 3000)

then.text: Text.PrintStringNow("Deliver the bike to the client's daughter.", 5000)

statements.text: Text.PrintStringNow("Oh, cool! Is that my new bike?!", 3000)
Text.PrintStringNow("No, it's the Popemobile. Yes, this is your bike.", 5000)
Text.PrintStringNow("Haha, very funny. Say, could you take me for a ride? I want to see how fast it can go!", 5000)
Text.PrintStringNow("As long as you don't tell my boss, I'll take you anywhere your heart desires.", 5000)
Text.PrintStringNow("Oh, yay! This is going to be so much fun!", 3000)
Text.PrintString("Take the bike for a spin around the city.", 5000)

then.text: Text.PrintStringNow("OK, that's enough dilly-dallying. Take her home.", 5000)

statements.text: Text.PrintString("The bike is trashed! Get it repaired!", 3000)
Text.PrintString("The bike is trashed! Get it repaired!", 3000)
Text.PrintString("Hey. This is your boss. Meet me on the Jetty east of the Golf Course.", 4000)

then.text: Text.PrintString("Did you think I wouldn't find out?", 3000)
Text.PrintString("I know what you did with our client's daughter!", 5000)
Text.PrintString("Boss, it wasn't like that! I swear!", 5000)
Text.PrintString("Save your excuses for someone who gives a shit!", 5000)
Text.PrintBigString("The End Is Simply the Beginning...", 6000, TextStyle.BottomRight)
